text: ana: Quick check-in on the autoscale panel mock. Main asks: make it obvious what 'burst' means, ensure steppers work for keyboard users, and add a non-blocking quota hint when pool limits conflict. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/zzz/autoscale-ux leo: Burst needs a parenthetical. I like: 'Burst (temporary quota)'. Clarify billing in helper text: 'Billed at on-demand rates.' priya: Accessibility: steppers should be step=1, announce updates via aria-live, and have a clear 4px focus ring. Also ensure disabled controls expose a tooltip and are reachable via keyboard. tess: For pool chips, add a tiny GPU badge (A100 / T4) and region label. Testers mixed up pools when type wasn't visible. If pool doesn't support burst, disable burst control and show explanatory tooltip: 'Burst unavailable for this pool.' leo: On pool change -> do not mutate user inputs silently. Show an inline orange suggestion banner with two actions: 'Lower Max to X' and 'Pick another pool'. Banner should be tabbable and use role="alert" so SRs read it. priya: sample aria for spinbutton: ```html Max capacity updated to 12 GPUs ``` ana: small copy ask: replace terse labels 'Min'/'Max' with 'Min reserved GPUs' and 'Max capacity (incl. burst)'. ux-bot: Accessibility checklist: keyboard focus, visible focus ring, aria labels on chips, contrast >= 3:1 for helper text. ana: Plan: ship stepper accessibility + suggestion banner + chip badges this sprint. SLO slider copy and inline cost toggle for next sprint. Who pairs on stepper PR? leo: I'll pair with priya. Opening a draft PR now. tess: I'll file QA cases for keyboard flows and banner behavior. ana: thanks all — will pin final copy to Figma and tag a11y for review.
